compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3: Behavioral test `tests/workflows/test-red-test-blocker-merged-tree-scan.sh` opens two sub-PRs on same session branch \xe2\x80\x94 one removes RED marker, one re-introduces it \xe2\x80\x94 asserts merged-tree scan blocks session\xe2\x86\x92main merge. (Phase E Finding #11)

## Implementation Notes

Create `tests/workflows/test-red-test-blocker-merged-tree-scan.sh`.

**Test approach (Given / When / Then)**:
- Given: a fixture git repository with a `main` branch and a `session/test` branch
- Given: TWO commits on session/test (simulating two sub-PRs landing sequentially):
  - Commit A: removes `[test_foo]` from `.test-index`
  - Commit B (later): re-introduces `[test_foo]` for `src/foo.py` in `.test-index`
- Given: `scan-red-markers.sh` (from T2) is invoked with `base=main`, `head=session/test`
- When: the script runs the cumulative merged-tree scan
- Then: exit code is non-zero (because Commit B's re-introduction is in the cumulative state)
- AND: stderr lists `[test_foo]` flagged

**Additional scenario**:
- Given: a fixture session branch where session/test contains ONLY Commit A (RED marker removed and not re-introduced)
- When: scan runs
- Then: exit code 0 (no markers in cumulative state)

Test uses `mktemp` for isolated git repo, builds fixture commits, invokes `scan-red-markers.sh`, asserts exit codes and stderr content.

Add `.test-index` RED marker `[test_red_test_blocker_two_subpr]` for `plugins/dso/scripts/scan-red-markers.sh`.

## File Impact
| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| `tests/workflows/test-red-test-blocker-merged-tree-scan.sh` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | n/a (marker only) |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Behavioral test file exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/workflows/test-red-test-blocker-merged-tree-scan.sh
- [ ] Test asserts the two-sub-PR resurfacing scenario blocks merge
  Verify: grep -qE 'two.*sub.*PR|resurfac|re-introduc' tests/workflows/test-red-test-blocker-merged-tree-scan.sh
- [ ] Test asserts the no-resurfacing scenario passes (control case)
  Verify: grep -qE 'no.*marker|control.*case|exit 0' tests/workflows/test-red-test-blocker-merged-tree-scan.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_red_test_blocker_two_subpr\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] Test uses mktemp for isolated fixture
  Verify: grep -q 'mktemp' tests/workflows/test-red-test-blocker-merged-tree-scan.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user

AC AMENDMENT (plan-review F6): Specify exact fixture setup pattern.
- Test must build a 3-commit fixture: (1) initial commit on 'main' with baseline .test-index (no markers); (2) common ancestor commit on 'main'; (3) two commits on 'session/test' that simulate sub-PRs — Commit A removes a marker that was on main; Commit B re-introduces a marker for a different source file.
- The fixture uses 'git init' + 'git commit -m' chain in a 'mktemp -d' directory, NOT a real worktree.
- The test invokes scan-red-markers.sh with the actual SHAs of the base commit and the tip-of-session commit.
- [ ] Test fixture has at least 3 commits (initial, main divergence, session tip)
  Verify: grep -c 'git commit' tests/workflows/test-red-test-blocker-merged-tree-scan.sh | awk '{exit ($1>=3?0:1)}'
- [ ] Test passes explicit SHAs (not refs) to scan-red-markers.sh
  Verify: grep -qE 'scan-red-markers.sh.*\$\\{|scan-red-markers.sh.*\$\(git' tests/workflows/test-red-test-blocker-merged-tree-scan.sh
